hero_h1: St Patrick's Day Text & Symbol Generator
hero_tagline: Type a name or toast and style it in Celtic, gothic, and bold fonts, then copy shamrock, clover, and rainbow emoji, kaomoji, and ASCII art, or tap a ready-made Irish blessing to style it instantly.
intro: St Patrick's Day runs on a small, well-worn set of words: a blessing, a toast, and a joke about being pinched for not wearing green. This page gathers everything for styling them: curated Celtic-leaning and bold fonts you can preview on your own text, the shamrock, clover, and rainbow emoji people actually paste, Celtic knot and cross symbols, kaomoji, a few original ASCII art pieces, and a bank of Irish blessings, toasts, and captions, from the full "May the road rise up to meet you" to a two-word story caption.
hub_card_desc: Style a St Patrick's Day toast live, then copy matching fonts, symbols, kaomoji, and ready-made blessings.
